title: AC1027 solid MPOLYGON LTYPE XDATA target transport

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository fixture file was added.
scope.cross_product: One selected MPOLYGON target in each of model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, across all four source/output encoding pairs.
scope.linetype: Source-bound simple LTYPE with the existing MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA APPID provider.

xdata.payload: One ordered group-1005 soft-pointer to source handle 0xA900.

references.target: model-space MPOLYGON or named-block MPOLYGON, selected per profile

targets.fields: Same selected MPOLYGON version, fill and four-line boundary profile as the model-space target.

proof.source: Physical source records bind the group-1005 reference to the exact MPOLYGON record and owner in each selected section. Typed import checks exact DRW_MPolygon identity, version/fill distinction, one edge boundary loop, four ordered DRW_Line edges, default fill-color and annotation fields, x-direction, degenerate-loop count and extrusion.
proof.output: For each ASCII/binary source/output pair, physical output checks the target type, section, remapped handle/reference, owner, MPOLYGON version/solid fields, boundary path and edge types/coordinates, fill-color and annotation defaults, x-direction and degenerate-loop count. Fresh adapter readback checks the exact DRW_MPolygon type, owner, loop and selected fields.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the target independently refuses export and preserves the existing destination, then succeeds on same-adapter retry for all eight placement/encoding profiles. Separate model-space and named-block late-handle mutation cases refuse without replacing the destination and succeed after the source identity is restored.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 24.57 seconds); selector asserts the whole-test counts above

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds a generated target profile and classifier mapping.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 solid MPOLYGON profile with one edge-based path of four LINE edges in model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, for the authored ASCII/binary source/output combinations. Other path/edge forms, polyline boundaries, annotation/fill-color variants, patterns/gradients, seeds, versions and target pairings remain open.

This is selected boundary identity, field transport, output/readback and transaction evidence. It does not establish MPOLYGON fill/island rules, native rendering, independent CAD semantics, recursive document closure or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
next: Select another source-bound target, mixed set, XDATA composition or MLINE consumer operation; keep MPOLYGON semantics and native-rendering gates separate.
